title: General Knowledge
description: A little bit of everything. Take your time.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide dust gives Mars its reddish color.

questions.question: The largest ocean on Earth is the ______ Ocean.
questions.explanation: The Pacific covers about 165 million km².

questions.question: How many continents are there (most common count)?
questions.explanation: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America.

questions.question: Which of these are Nobel Prize categories? (Pick 3)
questions.explanation: There is no Nobel Prize in mathematics.
questions.hint: One of these famously does not exist.

questions.question: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
questions.explanation: It's far too narrow — this is a myth.

questions.question: Order these from smallest to largest:
In which country did the tango originate?
questions.explanation: Tango was born in Buenos Aires and Montevideo in the late 1800s.

questions.question: Water boils at 100°C at sea level — what is that in Fahrenheit?
Match the capital to its country:
questions.explanation: All four pairings are capitals of their respective countries.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.explanation: Diamond scores a 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: Babies have about 300 that fuse down to 206.

questions.question: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.explanation: Tall structures like the Empire State Building get struck many times a year.
